brand.sub: The text-first community for Nepalis living in Japan — visas, jobs, schools, housing, family and everyday life.

home.how1: Visa, jobs, school, rent, family — one common feed, no categories needed.
home.how2: Every valid post moves you toward the next level badge.
home.how3: Text only, multilingual filtering and real human moderators.

profile.privateNote: Email and real name are never shown. Optional fields appear only if you tick “Show publicly”.

auth.linkError: That link has expired or was opened in a different browser. If you were confirming your email, just log in. For a password reset, request a new link.

auth.agree: I am 18 or older (or have guardian consent) and agree to the Terms, Privacy Policy and Community Guidelines.
auth.invalidLogin: Wrong email or password, or email not confirmed yet.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.usernameRule: Change once every 30 days. Your old name stays reserved for you for 30 days.
settings.deleteWarn: Permanently deletes your profile, posts and replies and cancels any subscription. This cannot be undone.
settings.emailPrivate: Your email is private and never shown to anyone.

report.thanks: Thank you. Our moderators will review it.

premium.cancelled: Checkout cancelled. You were not charged.
premium.confirm: You are buying a monthly subscription: ¥200 (tax incl.) charged now and every month on the same date until you cancel. Cancel anytime from this page; access continues to the end of the paid period. No refunds for partial months except where required by law.
